title: Beatrix and the Static
author: Ansel Eastwick
blurb: Petra Oyelaran, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
